newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary sees MOL sale in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sees MOL sale in early 1997.

text.p: Hungary is likely to continue the privatisation of the oil and gas company MOL Rt in the first two months of next year, the privatisation agency APV said on Monday.
"The privatisation will probably continue in January, February," Miklos Kamaras, Deputy Chief Executive told Reuters.
"It is not likely, but not impossible that it will continue this year," he added.
The state holds an almost 60 percent stake in MOL. The rest of the shares are in the hands of foreign and domestic financial investors, employees and local municipalities.
Hungary had earlier said that it planned to sell further MOL shares to financial investors.
The shares are likely to be sold in tranches as Hungary is seeking the ways of generating as much revenue from MOL's privatisation as possible, Kamaras said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange MOL shares closed unchanged at 1,480 forints.
